title: Daily COVID-19 Cases by State
description: Daily COVID-19 cases at national and state level, with details on imported, recovered, active, and cluster cases.

fields.name: cases_new
fields.title: New Cases
fields.description: [Integer] Number of new cases reported in the 24 hours since the last report; note that this is based on the date of report and not the date of the test.

fields.name: cases_import
fields.title: Imported Cases
fields.description: [Integer] Number of new cases imported from abroad, i.e. inviduals who were infected outside the country

fields.name: cases_recovered
fields.title: Recoveries
fields.description: [Integer] Number of recoveries from COVID-19 reported in the 24 hours since the last report

fields.name: cases_active
fields.title: Active Cases
fields.description: [Integer] Number of COVID-19 cases who have not recovered or died

fields.name: cases_cluster
fields.title: Cluster-related Cases
fields.description: [Integer] Number of cases attributable to clusters; the difference between new cases and the sum of cases attributable to clusters is the number of sporadic cases

methodology: This dataset is produced by the Crisis Preparedness and Response Centre (CPRC) at the Ministry of Health, based on daily ground-level surveillance conducted to monitor the evolution of COVID-19 in Malaysia. Following Malaysia's transition to endemicity, the public reporting frequency was altered from daily to weekly. Nevertheless, internal surveillance is still conducted on a daily basis.
caveat: In general, the data presented here is based on the date of report rather than the date of the event.
publication: KKMNOW features a [dashboard on COVID-19](https://data.moh.gov.my/dashboard/covid-19) where you can explore the data in a more interactive manner!
